title: Birdcage Castle
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Three boys and three girls enter an abandoned amusement park looking for a missing friend, find themselves locked in and chained together, and must escape in pairs or not at all (Manga UP! Global blurb). Database tags describe a death-game survival story with puzzles, manipulation, jealousy and revenge; four volumes, listed as cut short.
life_message: It suggests that trust and cooperation under pressure decide who survives, while jealousy and revenge destroy (to verify).
